name: @felafel/backend
description: HTTP framework layer for Felafel services. Owns the Hono app factory (createHonoApp), the request-logger middleware, and shutdownBackend — the bounded-cap OTel flush helper every service calls on SIGTERM. Depends on @felafel/logs for the logger + OTel bootstrap; depends on @hono/zod-openapi for the OpenAPIHono primitive. Workspace-only; never published.
